text_block_list.name: Cesario
choice_data_list: You beat your personal best! Way to go!
We set a new best time, yay!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! Personally, that felt 
like a great run to me as well.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
The strain on my heels is minimal, and I 
feel less fatigue after running... It 
seems the new training menu you gave me 
suits my body well, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"To think that on top of shaving off time, 
it also reduces the physical strain on the 
body—"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
As expected of my partner. Please continue 
to let me learn from your expertise.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me. Do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I prepared this on my day off. Would you 
please accept it?

Opening the wrapped package, inside was a 
stylish aroma candle.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"This might be a bit out of the blue, but 
I really wanted to express my gratitude 
for everything you do for me every day."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Thank you as always for your guidance.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I picked out some relaxation items for 
you. Please use them whenever you're 
tired♪
choice_data_list:
I'm happy, but you didn't have to go this 
far for me—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm just doing what's only natural.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Even if it's second nature to you, or not 
something you think deserves thanks, it 
still makes me very happy."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
So there you have it♪ Please accept this 
along with all my gratitude!
choice_data_list:
...Well then, I'll take you up on that. 
Thank you!

text_block_list.text:
"That night—reflecting on the gratitude I 
received from Cesario, both on and off 
duty, I was soothed by the scent of the 
aroma oil she had given me."
